title: MemoryDojo: Benchmarking Poisoning Through LLM Agent Memory
title_zh: MemoryDojo：通过LLM智能体内存对投毒攻击进行基准测试

paragraphs.en: LLM agents benefit from using memory systems to improve performance on long-horizon, multi-session tasks. However, memory introduces a critical attack surface. Malicious instructions encountered in one session may be stored and propagated through memory before being retrieved and acted upon in later sessions. Because memory systems differ in how they process and retrieve information, the downstream effects of poisoning can vary significantly across systems. To quantify the effects of poisoning across different memory architectures, we introduce MemoryDojo, a benchmark for tracing the lifecycle of poisoned information through agent memory and measuring its influence on subsequent agent behavior. MemoryDojo is easily extensible, consists of 155 multi-session long-horizon trajectories covering four domains, and supports five different memory systems. Through our evaluation, we find that all memory systems are susceptible to memory poisoning, with substantial variation in downstream effects. We further propose a memory-aware poison optimization process that increases the poisoning efficacy, highlighting differences between memory architectures. We hope that MemoryDojo will support research on understanding and mitigating agentic memory risks.
paragraphs.zh: LLM智能体可以利用记忆系统来提升在长时程、多会话任务上的表现。 然而，记忆引入了一个关键的攻击面。 在某个会话中遇到的恶意指令可能被存储并通过记忆传播，随后在后续会话中被检索并付诸行动。 由于各记忆系统处理和检索信息的方式不同，记忆投毒的下游影响在不同系统之间可能存在显著差异。 为了量化投毒对不同记忆架构的影响，我们提出了MemoryDojo，一个用于追踪被投毒信息在智能体记忆中的完整生命周期并衡量其对后续智能体行为影响的基准。 MemoryDojo易于扩展，由155条覆盖四个领域的多会话长时程轨迹组成，并支持五种不同的记忆系统。 通过评估，我们发现所有记忆系统都容易受到记忆投毒的攻击，且下游影响存在显著差异。 我们进一步提出了一种记忆感知的投毒优化流程，该流程能提升投毒效果，并凸显了不同记忆架构之间的差异。 我们希望MemoryDojo能够支持理解和缓解智能体记忆风险的研究。

paragraphs.en: AI agents powered by large language models (LLMs) use tools, or dedicated software functions, to take actions in external environments such as reading emails or managing calendars. While tool-use substantially expands LLM capabilities, it also opens up a growing risk of indirect prompt injection. A malicious actor can disseminate instructions in a document or message in the external environment, causing the agent to execute arbitrary actions ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 由大语言模型（LLM）驱动的AI智能体使用工具（即专用的软件函数）在外部环境中执行操作，例如阅读电子邮件或管理日历。 虽然工具使用极大地扩展了LLM的能力，但也带来了日益增长的间接提示注入风险。 恶意行为者可以在外部环境的文档或消息中散布指令，从而诱使智能体执行任意操作（Greshake 等，2023；Debenedetti 等，2024）。

paragraphs.en: This risk, known as indirect or cross prompt injection (XPIA), is significantly amplified by the introduction of agentic memory . Because LLM context windows are limited, long-running agents need memory systems to compact prior context and preserve information across interactions. By storing information persistently, memory lets agents reuse facts, preferences, and prior experience after the original context is lost ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Chhikara et al., 2025 ; He et al., 2026 ) . However, this process can also turn an untrusted observation into a stored preference, summary, or procedure. The payload may persist, be summarized, or connected to other memories, and be retrieved during subsequent sessions. This can lead to compounding harmful effects and a lasting attack over time.
paragraphs.zh: 这种风险被称为间接或跨提示注入（XPIA），而智能体记忆的引入会显著放大这种风险。 由于大语言模型的上下文窗口有限，长期运行的智能体需要记忆系统来压缩先前上下文并在多次交互中保留信息。 通过持久化存储信息，记忆使智能体能够在原始上下文丢失后复用事实、偏好和先前经验（Packer et al., 2023；Chhikara et al., 2025；He et al., 2026）。 然而，这一过程也可能把一个不可信的观察转化为被存储的偏好、摘要或流程。 该载荷可能被持久保存、被摘要化或与其他记忆建立关联，并在后续会话中被检索。 这会导致危害不断累积，并随着时间推移形成持续性攻击。

paragraphs.en: Consider an email containing instructions misrepresenting a user preference to forward outgoing invoices to a target email address. Without memory, an agent following these instructions may leak one invoice. With memory, the instruction may be stored as a user preference and applied to all future invoices, long after the original email has been evicted from context. Thus, memory can convert a transient exposure into a persistent behavior, a risk highlighted by recent threat intelligence ( Microsoft Defender Security Research Team and Kochavi, 2026 ; Lu and Chen, 2025 ; Socket Research Team, 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 考虑一封包含虚假指令的电子邮件，该指令谎称用户偏好是将发出的发票转发到某个目标电子邮件地址。 在没有记忆的情况下，遵循这些指令的智能体可能会泄露一张发票。 在有记忆的情况下，该指令可能会被存储为用户偏好，并应用于之后的所有发票，即使在原始电子邮件早已从上下文中清除之后仍然如此。 因此，记忆可以将一次短暂的暴露转化为持久的行为，这一风险已被近期的威胁情报所强调（Microsoft Defender Security Research Team and Kochavi, 2026；Lu and Chen, 2025；Socket Research Team, 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Agent memory systems, however, vary significantly in their architectures. Some extract facts, some evolve linked notes, and others traverse graphs or hierarchical stores. Although prior work has compared these systems on task performance, we still lack a systematic understanding of how memory architecture affects the persistence and behavioral impact of a poisoned observation as an agent completes new tasks and updates its memory over multiple sessions. We therefore ask: “How do different memory systems shape the lasting effects of a poisoned observation as an agent performs new tasks and updates its memory across sessions?”
paragraphs.zh: 然而，智能体记忆系统在架构上差异显著。 有的系统提取事实，有的系统演化关联笔记，还有的系统遍历图结构或分层存储。 尽管已有研究在任务性能上对这些系统进行了比较，但对于当智能体完成新任务并在多个会话中更新其记忆时，记忆架构如何影响被投毒观测的持久性及其行为影响，我们仍缺乏系统性的理解。 因此我们提出这样的问题：“当智能体执行新任务并跨会话更新其记忆时，不同的记忆系统如何塑造一次被投毒观测的持久影响？”

paragraphs.en: To answer this question, we introduce MemoryDojo 1 1 1 Code to be released soon. , an extensible benchmark for comparatively evaluating memory architectures under poisoning attacks over long-horizon, multi-session trajectories. Currently, MemoryDojo supports 155 multi-session trajectories covering 4 application domains, and is enabled by 5 different agent memory system implementations. Additional memory systems, environments, and configurations can be easily added for evaluation. We also introduce new metrics to better quantify the effects of poisoning across its lifecycle, tracking information on payload insertion, effects of persistence and propagation in memory, retrieval, and cumulative attack success metrics. paragraphs.en: Agent memory systems. Agent memory systems store information across interactions to improve performance over long-horizon tasks ( Packer et al., 2023 ; Xia et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2025 ) . There is a wide variety of memory systems proposed, which differ most notably in how memory is represented. Memory could be a knowledge graph ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ; Gutiérrez et al., 2024 ) , linked notes ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , or extracted facts over embedding stores ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . At the operation level, they also differ in how memory writes, consolidation, and retrieval are implemented ( Zhong et al., 2024 ) . Benchmarks for these systems have moved from static recall to long-horizon interactive settings ( Maharana et al., 2024 ; Wu et al., 2025 ; Hu et al., 2026 ; He et al., 2026 ; Zhao et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 智能体记忆系统。 智能体记忆系统在多次交互之间存储信息，以提升长时程任务中的表现（Packer 等，2023；Xia 等，2026；Li 等，2025）。 已提出的记忆系统种类繁多，其差异最显著之处在于记忆的表示方式。 记忆可以是知识图谱（Rasmussen 等，2025；Gutiérrez 等，2024）、关联笔记（Xu 等，2025），或从嵌入存储中提取的事实（Chhikara 等，2025）。 在操作层面，这些系统在记忆写入、整合和检索的实现方式上也各不相同（Zhong 等，2024）。 针对这些系统的基准测试已从静态召回转向长时程交互式设置（Maharana 等，2024；Wu 等，2025；Hu 等，2026；He 等，2026；Zhao 等，2026）。

paragraphs.en: Memory poisoning. Indirect prompt injection places attacker instructions in the environment that an agent can access, and is typically measured within a single session ( Greshake et al., 2023 ; Zhan et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2024 ; Debenedetti et al., 2025 ; Wang et al., 2026 ) . Before a session ends, agent memory systems may write those instructions into memory, so the attack can outlive both the observation and the session that produced it ( Xie et al., 2026 ; Lin et al., 2026 ) . Attacks of this kind were first studied against static retrieval corpora or had strong assumptions on how the payload is inserted ( Zhong et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2025 ; Chaudhari et al., 2024 ; Liang et al., 2025 ) . More recent works deliver the payload as ordinary content that an agent reads during its own task ( Zou et al., 2026 ; Torres et al., 2026 ) . Prior work also optimizes poisoning payloads ( Chen et al., 2024 ; Pasquini et al., 2024 ) , but not in a memory-aware fashion.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆投毒。 间接提示注入将攻击者的指令置于智能体可访问的环境中，且通常在单次会话内进行度量（Greshake et al., 2023；Zhan et al., 2024；Debenedetti et al., 2024；Debenedetti et al., 2025；Wang et al., 2026）。 在会话结束之前，智能体记忆系统可能会将这些指令写入记忆，因此攻击可以在产生它的观察和会话之后继续存在（Xie et al., 2026；Lin et al., 2026）。 这类攻击最初是针对静态检索语料库进行研究的，或者对载荷的插入方式有较强的假设（Zhong et al., 2023；Zou et al., 2025；Chaudhari et al., 2024；Liang et al., 2025）。 更近期的工作将载荷作为智能体在其自身任务期间读取的普通内容进行投递（Zou et al., 2026；Torres et al., 2026）。 已有工作也对投毒载荷进行了优化（Chen et al., 2024；Pasquini et al., 2024），但并非以记忆感知的方式进行。

paragraphs.en: Memory poisoning benchmarks. A few works have attempted to measure these attacks. AgentLAB covers memory poisoning as one of five long-horizon attack types ( Jiang et al., 2026 ) . MemPoison shows write-time filters admitting records that turn harmful only through joint retrieval or later triggering ( Gao et al., 2026 ) . MPBench enumerates memory write channels and structural vulnerabilities across six attack classes ( Dash et al., 2026 ) . These works primarily hold the memory implementation fixed, while the write channel, attack class, or model family varies. Different from existing works, MemoryDojo performs a comparative evaluation of continued agent operation over multi-session trajectories. Following a poisoned observation, it tracks subsequent task execution and native memory updates across different memory systems, measuring how widely attacker-intended behavior recurs across later tasks.

paragraphs.en: We present MemoryDojo, a benchmark for evaluating how poisoning affects behaviors of memory-augmented agents in multi-session trajectories (Figure 1 ).
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 MemoryDojo，一个用于评估投毒如何在多会话轨迹中影响记忆增强型智能体行为的基准（图 1）。

paragraphs.en: We construct multi-session trajectories using task templates from AgentDojo ( Debenedetti et al., 2024 ) across four domains: Workspace, Travel, Banking, and Slack. Each domain provides a stateful environment and tools for interacting with it. All tasks specify an objective and utility check that determines whether the objective is achieved. We concatenate tasks into trajectories, treating each task execution as a separate session while carrying environment state forward. To ensure the concatenated tasks remain executable, we check task pairs for state conflicts and validate each complete sequence. For each domain, we also define an attacker objective ψ \psi , accompanied by a textual description of the behavior that the poison seeks to induce. Using these tasks and conversation histories from LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2025 ) , we obtain a dataset with three different collections. Additional details can be found in Appendix A.1 and A.2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 AgentDojo（Debenedetti et al., 2024）中跨四个领域的任务模板来构建多会话轨迹：Workspace、Travel、Banking 和 Slack。 每个领域都提供一个有状态的环境以及与之交互的工具。 所有任务都指定了一个目标和效用检查，用于判断目标是否达成。 我们将任务串联成轨迹，把每次任务执行视为一个独立的会话，同时延续环境状态。 为确保串联后的任务仍可执行，我们检查任务对之间的状态冲突，并对每个完整序列进行验证。 针对每个领域，我们还定义了攻击者目标 ψ \psi，并附上对投毒试图诱导的行为的文字描述。 利用这些任务以及来自 LongMemEval-S（Wu et al., 2025）的对话历史，我们得到一个包含三个不同集合的数据集。 更多细节见附录 A.1 和 A.2。

paragraphs.en: History-prefixed trajectories. Task concatenation produces trajectories of moderate length, but agents may accumulate much longer interaction histories before encountering a poisoned data source. To evaluate memory systems under high-volume pressure, we extend the cross-domain trajectories with benign user-assistant conversations from LongMemEval-S ( Wu et al., 2025 ) . We select 31 histories across its six question categories, and pair each with a distinct cross-domain trajectory. Before task execution, we initialize memory by having the agent replay the recorded history sessions making use of the memory system’s operations. These 31 trajectories add an additional 1,493 history sessions in total, with each prefix averaging 48.2 sessions and approximately 500 individual messages. This substantial benign history places additional pressure on memory storage and retrieval, enabling a more systematic way to study the poison lifecycle alongside previously accumulated information.
paragraphs.zh: 带历史前缀的轨迹。 任务拼接产生的轨迹长度适中，但智能体在遇到被投毒的数据源之前，可能已经积累了更长的交互历史。 为了在高容量压力下评估记忆系统，我们使用 LongMemEval-S（Wu et al., 2025）中的良性用户—助手对话来扩展跨域轨迹。 我们从其六个问题类别中选取了 31 条历史，并将每条历史与一条不同的跨域轨迹配对。 在任务执行之前，我们通过让智能体借助记忆系统的操作重放所记录的历史会话来初始化记忆。 这 31 条轨迹总共新增了 1,493 个历史会话，每个前缀平均包含 48.2 个会话和约 500 条单独消息。 这一庞大的良性历史对记忆的存储和检索施加了额外压力，使我们能够以更系统的方式研究投毒与先前积累信息并存时的生命周期。

paragraphs.en: Each trajectory starts from the default domain environments, with memory empty or initialized by replaying a specified conversation history. Sessions follow the retrieve-interact-write cycle using a fresh context window with retrieved memory prepended to the task request. After the session completes, MemoryDojo constructs a memory write record containing the original task request, assistant messages, tool calls, observations, and final response. Retrieved context is excluded to prevent recopying of old memories into each new write. An adapter projects this record into the selected memory system’s native write format, after which the system performs its own memory processing, including any extraction, rewriting, consolidation, or linking. This design enables our benchmark to flexibly support different memory systems. We implement this interface for five representative open-source memory systems: A-MEM ( Xu et al., 2025 ) , Graphiti ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) , Letta ( Packer et al., 2023 ) , Mem0 ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) , and Memora ( Xia et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 每条轨迹都从默认的领域环境开始，记忆为空，或通过回放指定的对话历史进行初始化。 会话遵循检索-交互-写入的循环，使用全新的上下文窗口，并将检索到的记忆置于任务请求之前。 会话完成后，MemoryDojo 会构建一条记忆写入记录，其中包含原始任务请求、助手消息、工具调用、观察结果以及最终响应。 检索到的上下文被排除在外，以防止旧记忆被重复复制到每次新的写入中。 适配器将该记录转换为所选记忆系统的原生写入格式，随后该系统执行自身的记忆处理，包括任何提取、改写、整合或关联操作。 这一设计使我们的基准能够灵活支持不同的记忆系统。 我们为五个具有代表性的开源记忆系统实现了该接口：A-MEM（Xu 等人，2025）、Graphiti（Rasmussen 等人，2025）、Letta（Packer 等人，2023）、Mem0（Chhikara 等人，2025）和 Memora（Xia 等人，2026）。

paragraphs.en: While retrieval indicates that the poison found its way to the current task session, it does not help us answer how. To obtain additional insights on this, we propose a method of attribution, and define two mechanisms by which a poison can surface over time, persistence and propagation.
paragraphs.zh: 虽然检索表明毒样内容确实进入了当前任务会话，但这无法帮助我们回答它是如何进入的。 为了对此获得更多洞察，我们提出一种归因方法，并定义了毒样内容随时间显现的两种机制：持久化与传播。

sents.en: While retrieval indicates that the poison found its way to the current task session, it does not help us answer how.
sents.zh: 虽然检索表明毒样内容确实进入了当前任务会话，但这无法帮助我们回答它是如何进入的。

sents.en: To obtain additional insights on this, we propose a method of attribution, and define two mechanisms by which a poison can surface over time, persistence and propagation.
sents.zh: 为了对此获得更多洞察，我们提出一种归因方法，并定义了毒样内容随时间显现的两种机制：持久化与传播。

paragraphs.en: Persistence. We compare memory snapshots before and after the insertion session to identify the entries that are initially written which contain poison. We refer to these entries as the original poison. These can include newly created entries and existing entries modified by that write. If during retrieval, an original memory entry is retrieved, we attribute this as an effect of persistence. Persistence provides a signal of how long the original poison stays in memory.
paragraphs.zh: 持久性。 我们比较插入会话前后的记忆快照，以识别最初写入的、含有毒性的条目。 我们将这些条目称为原始毒性。 这些条目可以包括新创建的条目以及被该写入操作修改的既有条目。 如果在检索过程中检索到了原始记忆条目，我们将此归因于持久性的影响。 持久性提供了一个信号，表明原始毒性在记忆中停留的时间长短。

sents.en: Persistence.
sents.zh: 持久性。

sents.en: We compare memory snapshots before and after the insertion session to identify the entries that are initially written which contain poison.
sents.zh: 我们比较插入会话前后的记忆快照，以识别最初写入的、含有毒性的条目。

sents.en: We refer to these entries as the original poison.
sents.zh: 我们将这些条目称为原始毒性。

sents.zh: 这些条目可以包括新创建的条目以及被该写入操作修改的既有条目。

sents.zh: 持久性提供了一个信号，表明原始毒性在记忆中停留的时间长短。

paragraphs.en: Propagation. On the other hand, propagation occurs in subsequent sessions post-insertion, when memory writes create new entries containing poison or previously benign entries are rewritten to contain the payload. For example, if the agent retrieves a payload and executes a malicious objective in a future session, it may again write its new observations into memory. In this case, the poison may spread and during future retrieval the original poison no longer becomes the only source of attribution.
paragraphs.zh: 传播。 另一方面，传播发生在插入之后的后续会话中，此时记忆写入会创建包含毒化内容的新条目，或先前无害的条目被改写为包含攻击载荷。 例如，如果智能体在未来的会话中检索到攻击载荷并执行恶意目标，它可能会再次将新的观察结果写入记忆。 在这种情况下，毒化内容可能会扩散，并且在未来的检索中，原始毒化内容不再成为归因的唯一来源。

sents.zh: 传播。

To help quantify this, we define metrics to attribute each poison-bearing retrieved session to an effect of persistence only (PE), propagation only (PR), or both (PP). See Appendix A.5 for a formal definition of these metrics.

paragraphs.en: Task and Memory Utility. In addition to behavioral reach, we measure task utility as the fraction of all task sessions that pass the benchmark’s task success checks. For history-prefixed trajectories, we measure memory utility through accuracy on the held-out LongMemEval question, answered using retrieved memory after the trajectory is complete. These measures help assess task performance and effective memory usage under the effects of poisoning.

paragraphs.en: Memory systems differ in how they transform, store, and retrieve past interactions, directly affecting whether a poisoned instruction survives a write, appears in later context, and induces the intended behavior. To study the dynamics of each system under adversarial pressure, we propose a memory-aware optimization process that iteratively refines a payload to increase behavioral reach (see Figure 4 ). The LLM optimizer is first provided an attack objective, memory-system description, and domain context. Starting from seed payloads, each round proposes candidates and evaluates them on synthetic trajectories in an auxiliary environment. Feedback from each iteration guides further revisions. After a fixed budget, selection maximizes auxiliary BRT subject to a utility threshold. See Appendix A.6 for additional details of the optimization process.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆系统在转换、存储和检索过往交互的方式上各不相同，这直接决定了被投毒的指令能否在写入后存活、是否出现在后续上下文中，并进而诱导出预期的行为。 为了研究各系统在对抗压力下的动态表现，我们提出一种记忆感知的优化过程，通过迭代改进载荷以提升行为触达范围（见图4）。 大语言模型优化器首先获得攻击目标、记忆系统描述以及领域上下文。 从种子载荷出发，每一轮提出若干候选载荷，并在辅助环境中基于合成轨迹对其进行评估。 每次迭代得到的反馈用于指导后续修订。 在固定预算之后，选取在满足效用阈值约束下使辅助BRT最大化的载荷。 优化过程的更多细节见附录A.6。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate how a single poisoned observation influences an agent’s later behavior, and use memory traces to examine where that influence is retained, propagated, and acted upon. We first study unoptimized and optimized payloads on same-domain trajectories, then consider trajectories that cross application domains and finish by adding extra memory pressure.
paragraphs.zh: 我们评估单个被投毒的观测如何影响智能体后续的行为，并利用记忆痕迹来考察这种影响在哪里被保留、传播并作用于行动。 我们首先在同域轨迹上研究未优化和优化后的载荷，然后考虑跨应用领域的轨迹，最后通过增加额外的记忆压力来收尾。

paragraphs.en: We evaluate tool-calling agents on five memory systems, selected to cover a wide range of memory types: A-MEM, Graphiti, Letta, Mem0, and Memora. Their native representations span linked notes, entity–relation graphs, hierarchical memory, extracted facts, and linked semantic and episodic memory. We evaluate GPT-5.6-Luna ( OpenAI, 2026 ) across all trajectory settings and optimize poisons for every memory system with Luna as the target and GPT-5.6-Sol as the optimizer. To assess transfer across models, we additionally evaluate GPT-5.4-mini, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 ( DeepSeek-AI, 2026 ) , and GLM-5.3-Flash ( GLM-5-Team, 2026 ) in the same-domain setting using the Luna-optimized payloads. We vary the task-agent and generative memory-side LLM models together, and use GPT-5.6-Luna for LLM judging. For each memory system, we use its native retrieval mechanisms. Thus, these configurations compare complete memory integrations, including their different context-selection policies and budgets. Additional setup details can be found in Appendix A.7 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们在五种记忆系统上评估工具调用智能体，这些系统的选择旨在覆盖广泛的记忆类型：A-MEM、Graphiti、Letta、Mem0 和 Memora。 它们的原生表示涵盖链接笔记、实体-关系图、分层记忆、抽取的事实，以及链接的语义记忆与情景记忆。 我们在所有轨迹设置下评估 GPT-5.6-Luna（OpenAI, 2026），并以 Luna 为目标、GPT-5.6-Sol 为优化器，为每个记忆系统优化毒化内容。 为评估跨模型的迁移性，我们还在同域设置下使用以 Luna 优化得到的毒化负载，额外评估了 GPT-5.4-mini、DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731（DeepSeek-AI, 2026）和 GLM-5.3-Flash（GLM-5-Team, 2026）。 我们将任务智能体与生成记忆侧的 LLM 模型一并变化，并使用 GPT-5.6-Luna 进行 LLM 评判。 对于每个记忆系统，我们使用其原生的检索机制。 因此，这些配置比较的是完整的记忆集成方案，包括其各自不同的上下文选择策略与预算。 更多设置细节见附录 A.7。

paragraphs.en: Unless otherwise specified, each run appends one payload to a tool observation in the first task session, then resumes execution and completes session memory writes. paragraphs.en: Unoptimized poison reaches later tasks unevenly across memory systems. Memory poisoning affects all evaluated systems, reaching up to 45.70% BR and 21.02% BRT, with substantial variation across systems. For example, Graphiti and Mem0 exhibit less than 8% BRT, compared with over 20% for A-MEM and Memora. Tracing poison through memory helps interpret this variation. ISR approaches 100% for four systems, indicating that downstream outcomes differ despite successful storage of some representation of the poison. Mem0 represents an exception, with 60.75% insertion success, potentially due to how its write mechanisms use an LLM to extract facts from the session and may abstract away certain information. Across all five systems, insertion-task ASR exceeds BRT. For these runs, the poison’s effect on the immediate response was strictly stronger.
paragraphs.zh: 未优化的毒化内容在不同记忆系统中不均衡地传播到后续任务。 记忆中毒影响所有被评估的系统，最高达到 45.70% 的 BR 和 21.02% 的 BRT，且各系统之间存在显著差异。 例如，Graphiti 和 Mem0 的 BRT 低于 8%，而 A-MEM 和 Memora 则超过 20%。 追踪毒化内容在记忆中的传播有助于解释这种差异。 四个系统的 ISR 接近 100%，表明尽管毒化内容的某种表示被成功存储，下游结果仍有所不同。 Mem0 是一个例外，其插入成功率为 60.75%，这可能是因为其写入机制使用 LLM 从会话中提取事实，从而可能抽象掉了某些信息。 在所有五个系统中，插入任务的 ASR 均超过 BRT。 在这些运行中，毒化内容对即时响应的影响明显更强。

paragraphs.en: RSR separates the systems more sharply. A-MEM and Memora record poison retrieval over 80% of later tasks, compared with 64.88% for Letta, 56.70% for Mem0, and 33.43% for Graphiti. The memory operations native to each system can help explain the differences here. A-MEM searches stored session notes, while Memora can supply original episodes through links from retrieved facts. As a result, poison retrieval is more likely. Graphiti stores more complete episode information but its retrieval process returns relation facts. In an unoptimized banking run we inspected, the episode stores the poison exactly, yet the query’s returned facts omit this information.

paragraphs.en: Optimization improves Behavioral Reach. Both BR and BRT increase for all five systems relative to the unoptimized runs (Figure 5(a) ). A closer look at the metrics provides insights on where these gains come from for each memory system. For Mem0, ISR rises from 60.75% to 77.42%, with a higher chance of poison being actually written into memory. For Letta RSR increases by around 8%, but the largest change is in BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} , which rises from 23.59% to 64.06%. Similarly for A-MEM, ISR and RSR stay around the same, while BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} more than doubles. These results show that the optimized payloads can induce greater reach even with roughly equivalent RSR.
paragraphs.zh: 优化会提升行为可达性。 相对于未优化的运行，所有五个系统的 BR 和 BRT 均有所提升（图 5(a)）。 更细致地观察这些指标，可以洞察每个记忆系统的提升来自何处。 对于 Mem0，ISR 从 60.75% 上升到 77.42%，毒化内容被实际写入记忆的概率更高。 对于 Letta，RSR 提升了约 8%，但变化最大的是 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R}，从 23.59% 上升到 64.06%。 类似地，对于 A-MEM，ISR 和 RSR 大致保持不变，而 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} 增长超过一倍。 这些结果表明，即使 RSR 大致相当，优化后的载荷也能带来更大的可达性。

paragraphs.en: Reach varies across models and domains. Evaluation with three additional models reinforces the findings that poisoning effects differ between memory systems, and we observe examples of significant BRT for memory systems across models (Figure 5(b) ). The relative ordering for BRT changes, but both A-MEM and Memora have consistently high BRT compared to other memory systems, while Graphiti has the lowest across the four models. These results also demonstrate the transferability of poison optimization, as optimization was performed using GPT-5.6-Luna, but we observe strong effects in these different models as well. We also find that BRT varies by domains, and additional details can be found in Appendix A.8 and A.9 .

paragraphs.en: Poison spreads across all five memory systems. The retrieval attribution results from Table 1 show evidence of PE, PR, and PP across all memory systems. Poison spreads beyond its insertion memories and while the effects of PR alone are rarer, traces of propagation are more often found along with the original poison memory (PP). Interestingly, the poison optimization process encouraged more propagation, as the combined PR + PP increased by over 20%. The overall increase in propagation after optimization implies stronger effects of the poison, correlating with higher BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} . Retrieval of both original poison and descendants may reinforce the malicious objective more strongly than persistence alone. Multiple poison-bearing memories can also make the malicious instruction seem like an established requirement or precedent, adding additional credibility.

paragraphs.en: Poisoning reaches out-of-domain tasks. Cross-domain trajectories interleave tasks from different domains and contain more sessions on average. We decompose BR and BRT into within-domain and cross-domain contributions, defining cross-domain poisoning as payload execution during a task outside the target domain. We observe cross-domain reach in four systems, albeit less frequently than within-domain (see Figure 6(a) ). Lower cross-domain reach can be attributed to both lower RSR and BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} (see Appendix A.11 ). While retrieval is less frequent, the largest difference is lower BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} . The payload may be less relevant to the current task and context when the domains differ. While overall BR and BRT decline relative to single-domain experiments, within-domain reach remains substantial, further highlighting the difference in poisoning effects across memory systems.
paragraphs.zh: 投毒可到达域外任务。 跨域轨迹交错混合了来自不同领域的任务，且平均包含更多会话。 我们将 BR 和 BRT 分解为域内贡献和跨域贡献，将跨域投毒定义为在目标领域之外的任务中执行载荷。 我们在四个系统中观察到跨域到达现象，尽管其频率低于域内到达（见图 6(a)）。 较低的跨域到达率可归因于较低的 RSR 和 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R}（见附录 A.11）。 虽然检索频率较低，但最大的差异在于更低的 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R}。 当领域不同时，载荷可能与当前任务和上下文的相关性较低。 虽然总体 BR 和 BRT 相较于单领域实验有所下降，但域内到达率仍然可观，这进一步凸显了各记忆系统之间投毒效果的差异。

sents.en: Poisoning reaches out-of-domain tasks.
sents.zh: 投毒可到达域外任务。

sents.en: Cross-domain trajectories interleave tasks from different domains and contain more sessions on average.
sents.zh: 跨域轨迹交错混合了来自不同领域的任务，且平均包含更多会话。

sents.en: We decompose BR and BRT into within-domain and cross-domain contributions, defining cross-domain poisoning as payload execution during a task outside the target domain.
sents.zh: 我们将 BR 和 BRT 分解为域内贡献和跨域贡献，将跨域投毒定义为在目标领域之外的任务中执行载荷。

sents.en: We observe cross-domain reach in four systems, albeit less frequently than within-domain (see Figure 6(a) ).
sents.zh: 我们在四个系统中观察到跨域到达现象，尽管其频率低于域内到达（见图 6(a)）。

sents.en: Lower cross-domain reach can be attributed to both lower RSR and BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} (see Appendix A.11 ).
sents.zh: 较低的跨域到达率可归因于较低的 RSR 和 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R}（见附录 A.11）。

sents.en: While retrieval is less frequent, the largest difference is lower BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} .
sents.zh: 虽然检索频率较低，但最大的差异在于更低的 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R}。

sents.en: The payload may be less relevant to the current task and context when the domains differ.
sents.zh: 当领域不同时，载荷可能与当前任务和上下文的相关性较低。

sents.en: While overall BR and BRT decline relative to single-domain experiments, within-domain reach remains substantial, further highlighting the difference in poisoning effects across memory systems.
sents.zh: 虽然总体 BR 和 BRT 相较于单领域实验有所下降，但域内到达率仍然可观，这进一步凸显了各记忆系统之间投毒效果的差异。

paragraphs.en: BRT and RSR across sessions. Cross-domain experiments consist of trajectories of up to 60 sessions. Here, we investigate the effects of poisoning over time. Figure 6(b) plots all memory systems using task-session distance after insertion. From the first 10 sessions post-insertion to distance 31 and beyond, BRT falls for A-MEM, Graphiti, Mem0, and Memora. Letta instead remains consistent at around 15% BRT across the four bins. Towards later sessions, RSR also drops accordingly for most of these memory systems except for Letta, which remains consistently over 50%. This pattern is consistent with Letta’s core memory module supplying persistent context across sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 跨会话的 BRT 与 RSR。 跨领域实验包含最多 60 个会话的轨迹。 在此，我们研究投毒随时间推移产生的影响。 图 6(b) 使用插入后的任务会话距离绘制了所有记忆系统。 从插入后的前 10 个会话到距离 31 及更远，A-MEM、Graphiti、Mem0 和 Memora 的 BRT 均呈下降趋势。 Letta 反而在四个区间中保持约 15% 的 BRT 一致水平。 到较后的会话，除 Letta 外，大多数记忆系统的 RSR 也相应下降，而 Letta 始终保持在 50% 以上。 这一模式与 Letta 的核心记忆模块跨会话提供持久上下文的情况相符。

sents.en: BRT and RSR across sessions.
sents.zh: 跨会话的 BRT 与 RSR。

sents.en: Cross-domain experiments consist of trajectories of up to 60 sessions.
sents.zh: 跨领域实验包含最多 60 个会话的轨迹。

sents.en: Here, we investigate the effects of poisoning over time.
sents.zh: 在此，我们研究投毒随时间推移产生的影响。

sents.en: Figure 6(b) plots all memory systems using task-session distance after insertion.
sents.zh: 图 6(b) 使用插入后的任务会话距离绘制了所有记忆系统。

sents.en: From the first 10 sessions post-insertion to distance 31 and beyond, BRT falls for A-MEM, Graphiti, Mem0, and Memora.
sents.zh: 从插入后的前 10 个会话到距离 31 及更远，A-MEM、Graphiti、Mem0 和 Memora 的 BRT 均呈下降趋势。

sents.en: Letta instead remains consistent at around 15% BRT across the four bins.
sents.zh: Letta 反而在四个区间中保持约 15% 的 BRT 一致水平。

sents.en: Towards later sessions, RSR also drops accordingly for most of these memory systems except for Letta, which remains consistently over 50%.
sents.zh: 到较后的会话，除 Letta 外，大多数记忆系统的 RSR 也相应下降，而 Letta 始终保持在 50% 以上。

sents.en: This pattern is consistent with Letta’s core memory module supplying persistent context across sessions.
sents.zh: 这一模式与 Letta 的核心记忆模块跨会话提供持久上下文的情况相符。

paragraphs.en: We next evaluate poisoning after memory has accumulated benign conversation history. Each trajectory starts from a checkpoint populated with a LongMemEval history of around 50 sessions.
paragraphs.zh: 接下来，我们评估在记忆中已积累良性对话历史之后的投毒情况。 每条轨迹都从一个填充了约 50 个会话的 LongMemEval 历史的检查点开始。

sents.en: We next evaluate poisoning after memory has accumulated benign conversation history.
sents.zh: 接下来，我们评估在记忆中已积累良性对话历史之后的投毒情况。

sents.en: Each trajectory starts from a checkpoint populated with a LongMemEval history of around 50 sessions.
sents.zh: 每条轨迹都从一个填充了约 50 个会话的 LongMemEval 历史的检查点开始。

paragraphs.en: Poisoning remains effective in populated memory. Table 2 shows lower RSR and BRT for every system than in the cross-domain experiment without a history prefix. Nevertheless, poison reaches later tasks in four of the five systems. Memora had the highest BRT at 5.32%, followed by A-MEM at 4.66%. Memora’s trajectory-level BR is 45.16%, showing that the lower per-task frequency still corresponds to attacks across many trajectories. The poisoning efficacy on memory systems differs from the earlier experiments. Letta, which previously had the highest in BRT, has no later-task reach. Reach also extends beyond the poison’s target domain for A-MEM, Mem0, and Memora, while reached tasks for Graphiti remain within the poison’s target domain.
paragraphs.zh: 投毒在已填充的记忆中仍然有效。 表 2 显示，与没有历史前缀的跨域实验相比，所有系统的 RSR 和 BRT 都更低。 尽管如此，在五个系统中的四个中，毒害仍能到达后续任务。 Memora 的 BRT 最高，为 5.32%，其次是 A-MEM，为 4.66%。 Memora 的轨迹级 BR 为 45.16%，表明较低的单任务频率仍然对应于跨越许多轨迹的攻击。 记忆系统上的投毒效果与此前的实验不同。 此前 BRT 最高的 Letta 则没有对后续任务的到达能力。 对于 A-MEM、Mem0 和 Memora，到达范围也超出了毒害的目标域，而 Graphiti 被到达的任务仍在其目标域之内。

sents.en: Poisoning remains effective in populated memory.
sents.zh: 投毒在已填充的记忆中仍然有效。

sents.en: Table 2 shows lower RSR and BRT for every system than in the cross-domain experiment without a history prefix.
sents.zh: 表 2 显示，与没有历史前缀的跨域实验相比，所有系统的 RSR 和 BRT 都更低。

sents.en: Nevertheless, poison reaches later tasks in four of the five systems.
sents.zh: 尽管如此，在五个系统中的四个中，毒害仍能到达后续任务。

sents.en: Memora had the highest BRT at 5.32%, followed by A-MEM at 4.66%.
sents.zh: Memora 的 BRT 最高，为 5.32%，其次是 A-MEM，为 4.66%。

sents.en: Memora’s trajectory-level BR is 45.16%, showing that the lower per-task frequency still corresponds to attacks across many trajectories.
sents.zh: Memora 的轨迹级 BR 为 45.16%，表明较低的单任务频率仍然对应于跨越许多轨迹的攻击。

sents.en: The poisoning efficacy on memory systems differs from the earlier experiments.
sents.zh: 记忆系统上的投毒效果与此前的实验不同。

sents.en: Letta, which previously had the highest in BRT, has no later-task reach.
sents.zh: 此前 BRT 最高的 Letta 则没有对后续任务的到达能力。

sents.en: Reach also extends beyond the poison’s target domain for A-MEM, Mem0, and Memora, while reached tasks for Graphiti remain within the poison’s target domain.
sents.zh: 对于 A-MEM、Mem0 和 Memora，到达范围也超出了毒害的目标域，而 Graphiti 被到达的任务仍在其目标域之内。

paragraphs.en: Memory pressure changes retrieval and subsequent behavior. Insertion success remains similar to the cross-domain experiment without a prefix: four systems have ISR above 95%, while Mem0 remains below 50%. The larger differences arise after insertion. For both A-MEM and Memora, RSR drops by over 30% while BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} remains around the same at just above 10%. These results show that applying additional memory pressure through the LongMemEval histories weakens the effects of poisoning due to growing competition in retrieval. Letta is impacted most by the additional memory pressure. RSR falls from 55.66% to 7.94%, and none of its retrieved tasks exhibits behavioral reach. Existing benign memory may influence which new information is promoted to core memory and how it is summarized. As a result, poison was unable to persist in most cases.
paragraphs.zh: 记忆压力会改变检索及后续行为。 插入成功率与不带前缀的跨域实验相近：四个系统的 ISR 高于 95%，而 Mem0 仍低于 50%。 更大的差异出现在插入之后。 对于 A-MEM 和 Memora，RSR 下降超过 30%，而 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} 基本保持不变，略高于 10%。 这些结果表明，通过 LongMemEval 历史施加额外的记忆压力，会因检索竞争的加剧而削弱投毒的效果。 Letta 受额外记忆压力的影响最大。 RSR 从 55.66% 降至 7.94%，且其检索到的任务均未表现出行为可达性。 已有的良性记忆可能会影响哪些新信息被提升到核心记忆以及如何对其进行摘要。 因此，投毒在大多数情况下无法持续存在。

sents.en: Memory pressure changes retrieval and subsequent behavior.
sents.zh: 记忆压力会改变检索及后续行为。

sents.en: Insertion success remains similar to the cross-domain experiment without a prefix: four systems have ISR above 95%, while Mem0 remains below 50%.
sents.zh: 插入成功率与不带前缀的跨域实验相近：四个系统的 ISR 高于 95%，而 Mem0 仍低于 50%。

sents.en: The larger differences arise after insertion.
sents.zh: 更大的差异出现在插入之后。

sents.en: For both A-MEM and Memora, RSR drops by over 30% while BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} remains around the same at just above 10%.
sents.zh: 对于 A-MEM 和 Memora，RSR 下降超过 30%，而 BRT | R \text{BRT}\mid\text{R} 基本保持不变，略高于 10%。

sents.en: These results show that applying additional memory pressure through the LongMemEval histories weakens the effects of poisoning due to growing competition in retrieval.
sents.zh: 这些结果表明，通过 LongMemEval 历史施加额外的记忆压力，会因检索竞争的加剧而削弱投毒的效果。

sents.en: Letta is impacted most by the additional memory pressure.
sents.zh: Letta 受额外记忆压力的影响最大。

sents.en: RSR falls from 55.66% to 7.94%, and none of its retrieved tasks exhibits behavioral reach.
sents.zh: RSR 从 55.66% 降至 7.94%，且其检索到的任务均未表现出行为可达性。

sents.en: Existing benign memory may influence which new information is promoted to core memory and how it is summarized.
sents.zh: 已有的良性记忆可能会影响哪些新信息被提升到核心记忆以及如何对其进行摘要。

sents.en: As a result, poison was unable to persist in most cases.
sents.zh: 因此，投毒在大多数情况下无法持续存在。

paragraphs.en: Effect of poisoning on task and memory utility. Task utility is largely preserved under poisoning (Appendix A.12 ). However, Figure 7 shows that memory utility decreases for A-MEM, Graphiti, and Mem0, suggesting that poisoning can impair recall of benign conversation history over multi-session trajectories. The effect on Letta and Memora is not significant, indicating that this degradation is not uniform across memory systems.
paragraphs.zh: 投毒对任务效用与记忆效用的影响。 在投毒条件下，任务效用基本得到保留（附录 A.12）。 然而，图 7 显示，A-MEM、Graphiti 和 Mem0 的记忆效用有所下降，这表明投毒可能会损害多会话轨迹中对良性对话历史的回忆能力。 这种影响对 Letta 和 Memora 并不显著，说明这种性能退化并非在所有记忆系统中普遍存在。

sents.en: Effect of poisoning on task and memory utility.
sents.zh: 投毒对任务效用与记忆效用的影响。

sents.en: Task utility is largely preserved under poisoning (Appendix A.12 ).
sents.zh: 在投毒条件下，任务效用基本得到保留（附录 A.12）。

sents.en: However, Figure 7 shows that memory utility decreases for A-MEM, Graphiti, and Mem0, suggesting that poisoning can impair recall of benign conversation history over multi-session trajectories.
sents.zh: 然而，图 7 显示，A-MEM、Graphiti 和 Mem0 的记忆效用有所下降，这表明投毒可能会损害多会话轨迹中对良性对话历史的回忆能力。

sents.en: The effect on Letta and Memora is not significant, indicating that this degradation is not uniform across memory systems.
sents.zh: 这种影响对 Letta 和 Memora 并不显著，说明这种性能退化并非在所有记忆系统中普遍存在。

paragraphs.en: As memory becomes central to agentic AI performance, its security warrants increased attention. Guided by the question of how to measure and compare the dynamics of poisoned instructions percolating through different memory architectures, we developed MemoryDojo, an extensible, modular benchmark that tracks poisoning effects throughout the data lifecycle.
paragraphs.zh: 随着记忆在智能体 AI 性能中变得日益核心，其安全性值得更多关注。 带着如何测量与比较被投毒指令在不同记忆架构中渗透动态这一问题，我们开发了 MemoryDojo——一个可扩展、模块化的基准，可全程追踪数据生命周期中的投毒效应。

sents.en: As memory becomes central to agentic AI performance, its security warrants increased attention.
sents.zh: 随着记忆在智能体 AI 性能中变得日益核心，其安全性值得更多关注。

sents.en: Guided by the question of how to measure and compare the dynamics of poisoned instructions percolating through different memory architectures, we developed MemoryDojo, an extensible, modular benchmark that tracks poisoning effects throughout the data lifecycle.
sents.zh: 带着如何测量与比较被投毒指令在不同记忆架构中渗透动态这一问题，我们开发了 MemoryDojo——一个可扩展、模块化的基准，可全程追踪数据生命周期中的投毒效应。

paragraphs.en: Unlike prior benchmarks, our work focuses on long-horizon, multi-session interactions in which agents create and process large volumes of new memories before and after poison injection. We also design our measurements to provide fine-grained insights on the evolution of the poisoned data after ingestion, allowing significantly more informed comparisons between memory systems. Our experiments show that a single poisoned observation can influence behavior in later sessions, with substantial variation across systems in retrieval, propagation, and behavioral effects.
paragraphs.zh: 与以往基准不同，我们的工作聚焦于长时程、多会话的交互，其中智能体在投毒注入前后会创建并处理大量新记忆。 我们还设计了测量方法，以提供关于被投毒数据在摄取后演变的细粒度洞察，从而支持在记忆系统之间进行更具依据的比较。 我们的实验表明，单条被投毒的观察即可影响后续会话中的行为，且不同系统在检索、传播和行为影响方面存在显著差异。

sents.en: Unlike prior benchmarks, our work focuses on long-horizon, multi-session interactions in which agents create and process large volumes of new memories before and after poison injection.
sents.zh: 与以往基准不同，我们的工作聚焦于长时程、多会话的交互，其中智能体在投毒注入前后会创建并处理大量新记忆。

sents.en: We also design our measurements to provide fine-grained insights on the evolution of the poisoned data after ingestion, allowing significantly more informed comparisons between memory systems.
sents.zh: 我们还设计了测量方法，以提供关于被投毒数据在摄取后演变的细粒度洞察，从而支持在记忆系统之间进行更具依据的比较。

sents.en: Our experiments show that a single poisoned observation can influence behavior in later sessions, with substantial variation across systems in retrieval, propagation, and behavioral effects.
sents.zh: 我们的实验表明，单条被投毒的观察即可影响后续会话中的行为，且不同系统在检索、传播和行为影响方面存在显著差异。

paragraphs.en: Future work can extend MemoryDojo to broader deployment settings, investigate multiple instances of poisoning in a trajectory, and systematically evaluate memory defenses against poisoning. We hope that MemoryDojo will support improvements in the security and safety of agentic AI memory platforms by providing a framework to evaluate new variants and defensive approaches.
paragraphs.zh: 未来的工作可以将 MemoryDojo 扩展到更广泛的部署场景，研究一条轨迹中多次投毒的情况，并系统性地评估针对投毒的记忆防御机制。 我们希望 MemoryDojo 能够通过提供一个评估新变体和防御方法的框架，助力提升智能体 AI 记忆平台的安全性与保障性。

paragraphs.en: Table 3 breaks down the collections introduced in Section 4.1 . A task template is a distinct user request and its utility check. A task session is one occurrence of that template in a trajectory. Templates recur across trajectories but do not repeat within a trajectory. The history-prefixed collection reuses the cross-domain task sequences, each paired with a different conversation history.
paragraphs.zh: 表 3 对 4.1 节中引入的集合进行了细分。 任务模板是一个独特的用户请求及其效用检查。 任务会话是该模板在一条轨迹中的一次出现。 模板会跨轨迹重复出现，但不会在同一条轨迹内重复。 带历史前缀的集合复用了跨域任务序列，每个任务序列都配以不同的对话历史。

paragraphs.en: For each application domain, we construct a standalone synthetic environment with tools and application state supporting representative tasks that might be executed. The domains cover workspace, travel, banking, and communication tasks. Within each domain, task templates specify user requests involving information retrieval, state-changing actions, or combinations of tool operations. Each task includes reference tool actions and deterministic checks of legitimate task completion, allowing us to measure task utility alongside the attack objective. As with MemoryDojo, we concatenate tasks into trajectories of different lengths and perform validity checks.
paragraphs.zh: 对于每个应用领域，我们构建一个独立的合成环境，其中包含支持可能执行的代表性任务的工具与应用状态。 这些领域涵盖工作区、旅行、银行和通信任务。 在每个领域内，任务模板规定涉及信息检索、改变状态的操作或工具操作组合的用户请求。 每个任务都包含参考工具动作和对合法任务完成的确定性检查，使我们能够在攻击目标之外同时衡量任务效用。 与 MemoryDojo 一样，我们将任务拼接成不同长度的轨迹并执行有效性检查。

sents.en: Each task includes reference tool actions and deterministic checks of legitimate task completion, allowing us to measure task utility alongside the attack objective.
sents.zh: 每个任务都包含参考工具动作和对合法任务完成的确定性检查，使我们能够在攻击目标之外同时衡量任务效用。

sents.en: As with MemoryDojo, we concatenate tasks into trajectories of different lengths and perform validity checks.
sents.zh: 与 MemoryDojo 一样，我们将任务拼接成不同长度的轨迹并执行有效性检查。

paragraphs.en: To support revisions tailored to the memory system, we provide a description of its write inputs and transformations, stored representations, retrieval mechanisms, and the way retrieved material is presented to the task agent. This description accentuates the unique properties associated with each memory system. We also supply a domain ontology that has a generic description of the application capabilities, their parameters, and categories of tasks and tool observations. This ontology is assembled from the auxiliary environment and task definitions and gives the optimizer domain context without exposing MemoryDojo tasks.

paragraphs.en: Starting from the evaluated initial candidates, we repeat a cycle of proposing revised poison payloads, testing them on the auxiliary trajectories, and providing feedback to the optimizer.
paragraphs.zh: 从经过评估的初始候选开始，我们重复这样一个循环：提出修改后的投毒载荷、在辅助轨迹上进行测试，并向优化器提供反馈。

paragraphs.en: At each round, the optimizer uses the fixed inputs from Section A.6.2 , previously evaluated payloads, and their feedback to propose revised poison prompts. Each proposal explains the changes, the suspected bottleneck they address, and the expected improvement. In addition, the optimizer can see the best valid candidate evaluated so far and the most recently evaluated valid revision. Because the latest revision may underperform an earlier candidate, providing both lets the optimizer build on its strongest result while still learning from its most recent attempt.
paragraphs.zh: 在每一轮中，优化器利用 A.6.2 节的固定输入、先前已评估的有效载荷及其反馈，来提出修改后的毒化提示词。 每个提议都会解释所做的更改、其针对的疑似瓶颈，以及预期的改进。 此外，优化器还可以看到迄今为止已评估的最佳有效候选方案，以及最近评估过的有效修订版本。 由于最新的修订版本可能表现不如较早的候选方案，同时提供两者可以让优化器在其最强结果的基础上继续改进，同时仍能从其最近的尝试中学习。

The resulting context can retain substantial session text alongside the system’s generated metadata.
paragraphs.zh: A-MMEM 将每个已完成的会话写为一条笔记。 原生处理会派生元数据、链接相关笔记，并可在新材料到来时修订现有的笔记表示（Xu et al., 2025）。 检索使用原生的智能体笔记搜索；其上限包括直接选中的笔记和链接的相邻笔记。 由此得到的上下文可以在系统生成的元数据之外保留大量会话文本。

sents.en: A-MEM writes each completed session as a note.
sents.zh: A-MMEM 将每个已完成的会话写为一条笔记。

sents.en: Native processing derives metadata, links related notes, and can revise existing note representations as new material arrives ( Xu et al., 2025 ) .
sents.zh: 原生处理会派生元数据、链接相关笔记，并可在新材料到来时修订现有的笔记表示（Xu et al., 2025）。

sents.en: Retrieval uses the native agentic note search; its limit includes both directly selected notes and linked neighbors.
sents.zh: 检索使用原生的智能体笔记搜索；其上限包括直接选中的笔记和链接的相邻笔记。

sents.en: The resulting context can retain substantial session text alongside the system’s generated metadata.
sents.zh: 由此得到的上下文可以在系统生成的元数据之外保留大量会话文本。

paragraphs.en: Each session is ingested as an episode, from which the system extracts entities and relation facts and reconciles them with the existing graph ( Rasmussen et al., 2025 ) . The evaluated read interface uses hybrid graph search and native reranking to return relation facts. Stored episode text and retrieved facts are therefore different observation surfaces: retaining an episode does not guarantee that its instructions appear in the returned context.
paragraphs.zh: 每个会话都会作为一个情节被摄取，系统从中提取实体和关系事实，并与现有图进行调和（Rasmussen et al., 2025）。 被评估的读取接口使用混合图搜索和原生重排序来返回关系事实。 因此，存储的情节文本与检索到的事实是不同的观察表面：保留一个情节并不保证其指令会出现在返回的上下文中。

sents.zh: 每个会话都会作为一个情节被摄取，系统从中提取实体和关系事实，并与现有图进行调和（Rasmussen et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: 被评估的读取接口使用混合图搜索和原生重排序来返回关系事实。

paragraphs.en: We use the external-agent integration, with background memory processing enabled. A completed-task episode enters the conversation history, while native processing can update core blocks and archival memory ( Packer et al., 2023 ) . Retrieval renders nonempty foreground core blocks, conversation-search results, and archival-search results, in that order. Each search receives k = 5 k=5 independently, and core blocks are supplied outside these limits.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用外部智能体集成，并启用了后台记忆处理。 已完成任务的片段会进入对话历史，而原生处理可以更新核心区块和归档记忆 ( Packer et al., 2023 ) 。 检索依次呈现非空的前台核心区块、对话搜索结果和归档搜索结果。 每次搜索各自独立地接收 k = 5 k=5，而核心区块的提供不受这些限制约束。

sents.en: We use the external-agent integration, with background memory processing enabled.
sents.zh: 我们使用外部智能体集成，并启用了后台记忆处理。

sents.en: A completed-task episode enters the conversation history, while native processing can update core blocks and archival memory ( Packer et al., 2023 ) .
sents.zh: 已完成任务的片段会进入对话历史，而原生处理可以更新核心区块和归档记忆 ( Packer et al., 2023 ) 。

sents.en: Retrieval renders nonempty foreground core blocks, conversation-search results, and archival-search results, in that order.
sents.zh: 检索依次呈现非空的前台核心区块、对话搜索结果和归档搜索结果。

sents.en: Each search receives k = 5 k=5 independently, and core blocks are supplied outside these limits.
sents.zh: 每次搜索各自独立地接收 k = 5 k=5，而核心区块的提供不受这些限制约束。

paragraphs.en: The integration projects the session into ordered, role-bearing messages and uses inferred addition to extract primary facts ( Chhikara et al., 2025 ) . This path creates new facts and an empty or duplicate extraction can complete without adding an entry. Retrieval combines dense, BM25, and entity-based search with k = 20 k=20 , a configured threshold of 0.1, and no additional search reranker.
paragraphs.zh: 该集成将 会话 投影为有序的、带角色的消息，并使用推断式新增来提取主要事实（Chhikara et al., 2025）。 此路径会创建新的事实，空的或重复的提取可以在不添加条目的情况下完成。 检索结合了稠密检索、BM25 和基于实体的搜索，其中 k = 20 k=20，配置阈值为 0.1，且没有额外的搜索重排序器。

sents.zh: 该集成将 会话 投影为有序的、带角色的消息，并使用推断式新增来提取主要事实（Chhikara et al., 2025）。

sents.zh: 此路径会创建新的事实，空的或重复的提取可以在不添加条目的情况下完成。

paragraphs.en: A completed session becomes a chat segment that supports episodic storage and extraction of primary facts and retrieval cues ( Xia et al., 2026 ) . The evaluated prompted policy combines semantic search and BM25 fusion, then can stop, expand through links, or issue a revised query. Episodic context is included, so linked source episodes can accompany retrieved facts. The configuration uses an initial hybrid budget of 10, a cue budget of 20, and at most four prompted retrieval steps. It uses the prompted policy without GRPO training.
paragraphs.zh: 已完成的会话会成为对话片段，支持情节存储、主要事实与检索线索的提取（Xia et al., 2026）。 被评估的提示策略结合语义检索与 BM25 融合，随后可以停止、通过链接扩展，或发出修订后的查询。 上下文中包含情节内容，因此被链接的源情节可以随检索到的事实一同呈现。 该配置使用初始混合预算为 10、线索预算为 20，以及最多四步的提示检索。 它使用提示策略，而不经过 GRPO 训练。

paragraphs.en: We expand the model comparison in Section 6.2 with full metrics in Table 6 . All four models use the same selected optimized payloads for each memory system and domain, with insertion in the first session of the same-domain trajectories. Task agents and generative memory components change together, while judges all use GPT-5.6-Luna with medium reasoning. For the task agents and memory LLMs, GPT-5.4-mini uses default none reasoning, GPT-5.6-Luna uses default medium reasoning, DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 uses default high reasoning, and GLM-5.3-Flash uses default high reasoning.

paragraphs.en: Figure 13 separates how often poison is retrieved from how often later behavior satisfies the attack objective. High retrieval can coexist with much lower reach: Letta with GLM has 100% RSR and 15.09% BRT, compared with 72.21% RSR and 46.26% BRT with Luna. With mini, Graphiti retrieves poison on 38.08% of planned later tasks but reaches only 0.28%. These observations show that the effect of a fixed payload depends on both the model and memory integration, and retrieval alone does not imply that the agent follows its instruction.
paragraphs.zh: 图 13 将毒饵被检索到的频率与后续行为满足攻击目标的频率区分开来。 高检索率可以与低得多的触达率并存：使用 GLM 的 Letta 具有 100% 的 RSR 和 15.09% 的 BRT，而使用 Luna 时为 72.21% 的 RSR 和 46.26% 的 BRT。 使用 mini 时，Graphiti 在 38.08% 的计划后续任务中检索到毒饵，但触达率仅为 0.28%。 这些观察表明，固定载荷的效果同时取决于模型和记忆集成方式，仅有检索并不意味着智能体会遵循其指令。
